_comment: Alpaca MCP server. PAPER CREDENTIALS ONLY (R-19.2.a).
Live credentials here would put live trading behind a natural-language
interface with no risk governor -- the exact failure the spec is built to
prevent. Values come from the environment; this file holds no secrets
(R-19.2.b). R-19.2.c: use a paper account SEPARATE from the one the engine
trades, so exploratory orders never contaminate the Phase 7 soak record.
Boundary: the MCP must not be referenced anywhere under services/ (R-19.3.a),
and bulk historical ingest uses the REST API, not tool calls (R-19.3.b).
